title.narrative: Expansion of Stop TB Strategy; Reaching the Hard to Reach and Preventing Missed Opportunities - Eritrea (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Eritrea, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health of the State of Eritrea (MOH)This program has the following goals: Reduce TB incidence from 89 per 100,000 population in 2018 to 61.5 per 100,000 population by 2023. Reduce TB mortality from 17.4 per 100,000 population in 2018 to 8.5 per 100,000 population by 2023. The objectives of this program are: To increase TB treatment coverage (case detection ratio) from 61% (2018) to 74% and successfully treat at least 93% of DS-TB by 2023. To improve the treatment coverage and management of Drug resistant TB, Childhood TB, TB/HIV and other key populations. To strengthen supportive systems and policies for TB/Leprosy management by 2023. To strengthen evidence-based program monitoring and evaluation; and intensify operational research by 2023

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for ERI-T-MOHP04
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
Outcome indicators targets and results for ERI-T-MOHP04
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for ERI-T-MOHP04
Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid tests at the time of diagnosis
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Treatment success rate of RR TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of cases with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
